about_the_game:
Embark on an Epic Journey in a Fantasy World!

Assume the role of a master strategist, overseeing a diverse group of adventurers. Dispatch them on dangerous expeditions to discover ancient secrets, confront formidable creatures, and recover legendary treasures.





  • Recruit, train, and equip a team of unique adventurers, each with their own skills, strengths, and abilities.
  • Develop your base of operations, upgrading facilities and unlocking new abilities to support your adventurers in the field.
  • Balance your resources carefully, making tough decisions that will shape the destiny of your team.

Combine abilities to create synergy effect:








  • Send your adventurers on dynamic, procedural generated expeditions across a rich and varied fantasy world.
  • Navigate through treacherous dungeons, haunted forests, and ancient ruins, each filled with hidden dangers and valuable rewards.
  • Encounter diverse characters and make choices that will influence your standing in the world and open up new story-lines and quests.





  • Engage in tactical, turn-based battles where strategy and planning are key to victory. There is no Luck (expect in-game Luck attribute which has nothing to do with real-life Luck)
  • Utilize a wide array of abilities, spells, and combat techniques to outsmart and outmaneuver your foes.
  • Customize your combat tactics, tailoring your team's abilities to counter specific enemies and challenges.

Are you ready to lead your adventurers to glory and uncover the mysteries of this enchanted world? Gather your team, plan your strategy, and set out on an unforgettable journey in this exciting Fantasy RPG!
